observed_value: cost_currency populated as CAD/EUR/GBP on 14 rows
anchor_value: source places CAD/EUR/GBP in Par Amount/Units while Cost and Fair Value are dollar columns

culprit_citations.quoted_text: Investments- non-controlled/ non-affiliated (1) | Footnotes | Reference Rate and Spread | Interest Rate (2) | Maturity Date | Par Amount/ Units | Cost (3) | Fair Value | % of Net Assets

findings.detail: Foreign currency codes from the Par Amount/Units column were mapped into cost_currency; the adjacent Cost and Fair Value columns are dollar-denominated valuation columns.

rationale: FX03 is a real data error. The raw schedule header separates Par Amount/Units from Cost and Fair Value, and representative flagged rows show CAD, EUR, and GBP immediately before par amounts, not in the cost column. The table subtotal uses dollar signs for the same Cost and Fair Value columns, so the extracted non-USD cost_currency values reflect a column mapping/extraction gap rather than a valid non-USD cost denomination.
